blocks.name: Android 17
blocks.notes: Cells are on the #47ffbb/#34bc88 checkerboard; the sheet surround is #2a966c and block borders/empty cells are #237f5a - treat all four as transparent. Main grid: down row cols 0-32, left/right/up rows cols 0-28; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 empty). Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk, three 4-frame melee strings with white swoosh trails (6-9 hook, 10-13 straight punch, 14-17 front kick - the third string is the kick, so punch3 and kick share 14-17), 18-20 one-hand ki shot (18 ready stance, 19 palm out, 20 arm fully extended; same hand in both), 21 hurt flinch with a white hit spark, 22-23 block with a forearm across the face (22 with the block spark, 23 held), 24 cocky power-up stance with a hand at the chest (charge; engine aura on top), 25-28 Superman-style flight (body horizontal, hair and scarf streaming; down = flying toward the camera, up = away, boot soles showing), a 4-frame flutter loop with no baked shadow. Down row only: 29 reaching forward and 30 diving forward ('fall') are drawn side-on FACING LEFT (mirror them for a right-facing scene); the dive lands in 31, lying face-down toward the camera (used as ko - play fall then ko), and 32 lifts his head from that position. Lying frames use the 'flat' shadow mode so the body's bottom outline survives. A second block of cells at x=1088 (same grid, cols 34-39) repeats idle/blink/walk while holding a small red-and-white item in his right hand: 34 idle, 35 blink, 36-39 walk; the walk exists only for left/right and the up row has only 34, so carry falls back to the standing frame when facing down/up. No arms-raised frame: raise reuses the punch1 wind-up (6, fist raised beside the head). Palette: #000000 is the hair base, the black vest, every outline and the shadow; #737373 is shared by hair highlights, sleeve cuffs and shoes; #ffffff appears in eye whites, sleeve highlights, the item and the swoosh trails; the brown belt uses #946329 plus the skin shades #845218/#ad7b39 with a #5a5a5a/#949494 buckle, and the shoes mix the boots greys with the trouser blues. The baked ground shadow under the feet is #000000, the same colour as outlines/eyes, so strip it by geometry (the engine draws its own), never by colour.
